resources.string: This service reads nothing on your screen and does nothing by itself. Android only lets an app with an accessibility service on use the microphone during a call, so One Dialer Recorder needs it to record your calls. Recordings stay on this phone.
Lets One Dialer record your calls. Start and stop recordings from the call screen in One Dialer, and find them in One Dialer › Settings › Call recording.
Turn on One Dialer Recorder under Installed apps
If Android says the setting is restricted: open App info, tap ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then come back and turn the service on.
Shows while a call is being recorded
Stops the phone from switching the recorder off while it\'s idle
Recording laws differ by country. You are responsible for telling the other person and getting their consent where it\'s required.
Strong: lifts the other person more
